## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Distinguish deterministic tests, saved-evidence audits, and actual Ollama runs.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Documentation reflects the change.
- [ ] Lifecycle or failure changes have relevant regression coverage.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, model weights, or live indexes are included.
- [ ] Any new evidence has documented redactions and retains failures and raw outcomes.
- [ ] I have the right to submit these contributions under the MIT license.
